title: SIM Imaging and Analysis for Active Zone Release Sites in Dopamine Axons
author: Chuyu Chen
materials: Probed with the primary antibodies anti-EGFP (1:1000, Invitrogen), anti-mCherry (1:1000, Invitrogen), and anti-bassoon (1:300, Enzo). 48 to 72 hours at 4°C
Incubated with secondary antibodies—Alexa Fluor‱ 488, Alexa Fluor‱ 568, and Alexa Fluor‱ 647 (1:300, Invitrogen)

steps.title: Anesthetize and Prepare Mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize adult mice expressing Aldh1a1/Anxa1 Cre and FlpO using 3% isoflurane, maintaining it at approximately 1.5% during the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Administer subcutaneous Rimadyl (3 mg/kg) at the start of surgery.
Administer subcutaneous slow-release Buprenex (0.25 mg/kg) after surgery.
Administer an additional dose of Rimadyl (3 mg/kg) the following day.

steps.title: Perform Viral Vector Injection
steps.instruction: Inject a 1:1 mixture of AAV8 hSyn-Con/Fon-YFP (Addgene #55650, titer: 2.4x10¹³ GC/ml) and AAV8 Ef1a-Coff/Fon-mCherry (Addgene #137134, titer: 2.2x10¹³ GC/ml) unilaterally into the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNc).

substeps.instruction: Drill a 0.5-1 mm hole into the skull at stereotactic coordinates RC: -3.16 mm, ML: -1.50 mm, DV: -4.00 mm.
Insert a 0.5 µl Hamilton Neuros syringe and leave in place for 5 minutes after reaching target depth to allow for proper viral diffusion within the brain parenchyma.
Slowly inject 0.3 µl of the viral vector over a period of 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Striatal Sections
steps.instruction: Incubate 30 μm striatal sections in 5% goat serum with 0.2% Triton X-100/PBS for 2 hours.

substeps.instruction: Wash with PBS for 5 minutes (repeat twice).

steps.title: Acquire SIM Images
steps.instruction: Capture multichannel SIM images using a Nikon N-SIM Structured Illumination super-resolution microscope with a 100x objective lens (NA 1.4).

substeps.instruction: Capture nine images with 2D SIM and reconstruct with 3D SIM using Nikon Element to increase xy and z resolution.
Set illumination modulation contrast automatically via software.
Use the 3D crop function to remove edges.
Apply a resolution of 1950 x 1950.

steps.title: Segment Axons
steps.instruction: Segment axons using the surface creation tool.

substeps.instruction: Enable smoothing surface detail (Surface Grain Size = 0.0643 µm).
Perform background subtraction using local contrast with 'Largest Sphere' diameter set to 0.241 µm.
Apply auto-threshold value with user adjustments; set filter 'Number of Voxels Img=1' above the lower automatic threshold.
Use the 'Mask channel' function to set voxel intensity to 0 for fluorescence signals outside the surface for either Alexa488 (EGFP) or Alexa568 (mCherry).

steps.title: Measure Axonal Terminal Segments
steps.instruction: Measure the length of axonal terminal segments using the filaments tool.

substeps.instruction: Select the masked Alexa488 (EGFP) or masked Alexa568 (mCherry) as the source channel.
Set the seed points threshold to 6,000.
Perform machine learning pixel classification, discarding segments not overlapping with the surface and keeping those that overlap until they cover over 99% of the visible surface.

steps.title: Segment Bassoon Particles
steps.instruction: Segment bassoon particles using the surface creation tool.

substeps.instruction: Activate smoothing surface detail (Surface Grain Size = 0.06 µm).
Apply auto-threshold value with user adjustments; set Region Growing Estimated Diameter to 0.100 µm based on intensity.
Set 'quality' filter to automatic thresholds.
Set 'volume' filter between 0.003-0.04 µm³.
Set filter 'overlapped volume ratio to surface EGFP/mCherry' above 1.0.

steps.title: Calculate Density
steps.instruction: Calculate the density of bassoon objects in Excel.

substeps.instruction: Determine the number of bassoon objects and the total length of axonal terminal segments.
Calculate density as the number of bassoon objects relative to the total length of axonal terminal segments.

description: Background subtraction (local contrast) (Diameter of Largest Sphere =0.15µm) was employed
